steps: Group descendant selection drives actual canvas batch dragging and size-aware left alignment. Each action undoes/redoes as one Rust history step; sibling placement positions and author bytes remain unchanged when cancelled.

Search/select-all and real Shift+arrow keys create four atomic local position changes across two placements. The complete reviewed candidate and three390px locale layouts preserve IDs, offsets, shared fragments, other override fields and exact source bytes. Apply changes only editor memory.

Normal Save persists only the original recipe file; reopened preview retains all four stable instances and groups, author metadata and images. No executable job or reverse editing of a generated scene is introduced.
A single coordinate changed without an input event cannot reuse batch review approval or escape validation through changing selection; cancelling retains the saved recipe.

An external write after batch review is protected by ordinary Save baseline conflict handling. Cancelling retains both external author bytes and the complete local layout draft without forcing a write.
limitations: Real HTTP editor and Chrome only; no installed Tauri window or Android device acceptance.
Multi-instance position-only canvas layout in one existing recipe source session. No shared template editing, placement-offset change, executable recipe build or cross-file transaction.
